mainEntity.name: Should I choose carpet or hardwood for my living room?

acceptedAnswer.text: The choice between carpet and hardwood depends on your priorities. Carpet offers warmth, sound absorption, and a soft feel underfoot, making it ideal for comfort in living rooms and bedrooms. It also provides insulation, potentially lowering energy bills. Hardwood is durable, easy to clean, and adds a classic aesthetic that can increase home value. Consider your lifestyle, maintenance preferences, and desired comfort level when making this decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Carpet provides warmth, sound absorption, and comfort, while hardwood offers durability, easy cleaning, and a classic aesthetic. Your choice depends on comfort, maintenance, and style preferences.
